title: Pioneer Vintage Audio Parts Database
description: JSON Schema describing the public machine-readable dataset of vintage Pioneer audio component parts. The dataset cross-references Pioneer part numbers with the models and equipment categories in which those parts were specified.

x-dataset.normalization_rule: If a part number ends with a hyphen followed by exactly one character, that final two-character suffix is removed. Otherwise the part number is left unchanged.
x-dataset.normalization_purpose: normalized_part_number is a search and cross-reference key. Different original Pioneer part numbers may therefore share the same normalized value. A shared normalized value does not by itself establish physical or electrical interchangeability.
x-dataset.description_policy: Descriptions generally preserve terminology found in Pioneer source documentation and are not aggressively standardized.
x-dataset.na_policy: N/A indicates that the source record does not provide a Pioneer part number.

model.description: Pioneer model designation associated with the part record.

category.description: General equipment category of the Pioneer model.

part_number.description: Original Pioneer part number as recorded in the source data. The original suffix, if present, is retained.

normalized_part_number.description: Search-oriented version of the Pioneer part number. If the original part number ends with a hyphen followed by exactly one character, that suffix is removed. Otherwise the value is unchanged.

description.description: Description of the part as recorded in the source data. Terminology may vary between Pioneer documents.
